environment.description: Terraform provider binary running as a gRPC plugin on a bare-metal CI runner (Ubuntu 22.04). The provider process has unrestricted syscall access. Network egress is open to all destinations. The provider listens on a Unix socket with no additional transport encryption beyond gRPC. Timing measurements are possible via repeated Terraform plan/apply cycles with varying token guesses, as the CI runner has consistent low-jitter CPU scheduling (isolated cores via taskset, no noisy neighbors). The attacker has access to invoke terraform plan with arbitrary provider configurations.

config.kernel: 5.15.0-generic, no ASLR randomization for Go binaries
